name: Hey_6
short_caption: The robot waves its right hand to greet or get the attention of a visitor.
movement_description: The robot begins in a neutral standing posture. It raises its right arm forward and up to about shoulder height with its palm open and facing forward, performing a brief waving motion. It then smoothly lowers the right arm back down to its side, returning to the neutral resting posture.
safety_notes: The right arm extends forward and slightly outward during the wave. Ensure a clear workspace of at least 60cm in front of and to the right of the robot.
